changes.title: Classroom Sync Summary Modal Mobile Z-Index & Sidebar Layering Fix
changes.description: Elevated #classroom-sync-modal z-index to 12000 with backdrop blur and responsive full-bleed mobile display, ensuring the Git-diff briefing modal displays above the mobile Classroom flyout sidebar (z-index: 1101), creation FAB buttons (z-index: 1200), and all other sidebars across viewport sizes. Added backdrop dismissal listener.

changes.title: Classroom Sync Modal Decoupling & Expired Session Reconnect Diff Briefing
changes.description: Decoupled the Classroom Sync Briefing Modal (#classroom-sync-modal) from the Admin/CR Sync button, replacing modal popups during task database writes with lightweight toast notifications and reserving the diff modal exclusively for the Refresh button. Additionally enabled automated diff comparison upon reconnecting to Google Classroom after session token expiration, rendering the Git-styled diff briefing modal to showcase coursework and announcement modifications that occurred while offline/cached.

changes.title: App Script Syntax Error & Infinite Loading Fix
changes.description: Restored missing closing brace in theme initialization block within js/core/app.js, resolving Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'else' at line 1678 that prevented script evaluation and trapped users on the infinite loading screen.

changes.title: UI showLoading isAdmin Scope & Service Worker Response Clone Fix
changes.description: Resolved ReferenceError for isAdmin in UI.showLoading() and fixed asynchronous response cloning in sw.js staleWhileRevalidate to eliminate runtime console errors.

changes.title: Changelog Modal Min-Width & Desktop Responsive Layout
changes.description: Enforced min-width (600px) and max-width (780px) on the 'What's New in b1t-Sched' changelog modal for desktop screens below 1920px, preventing it from collapsing under the generic 460px modal constraints in responsive.css.

changes.title: Credential Resolution Permission Handling & Local Cache Fallback
changes.description: Implemented local credential mapping fallback for ID/initial login lookups when unauthenticated Firestore reads are restricted by security rules, and added explicit guidance directing users to deploy repository rules to Firebase.

changes.title: Faculty & Student ID / Initials Flexible Login Support
changes.description: Expanded login capabilities allowing faculty to log in with Faculty ID, initial (case-insensitive), or email without composite query index restrictions. Supported student login with ID (normalized across string/numeric formats and dashes/spaces) while retaining strict 10-16 digit requirement on set-details and email-only sign up.

changes.title: Install Prompt: 3-Row Architecture & Solid Background Across Themes
changes.description: Redesigned the PWA install prompt into a 3-row layout (Row 1: Icon + Title, Row 2: Description, Row 3: Action Buttons). Defined missing --bg-card token and applied solid, non-transparent card backgrounds for Light (#ffffff), Dark (#242424), and High Contrast (#141414) themes.

changes.title: Prevent Downward Viewport Scroll on Login Refresh & Logout
changes.description: Enforced manual browser scroll restoration and instant scroll-to-top on SPA view routing, user sign-out, unauthenticated redirects, and loading screen dismissals.

changes.title: Role Enforcement, Set-Details Lockdown & Default Light Mode
changes.description: Enforced strict role separation preventing student accounts from logging in as faculty and vice-versa. Locked the role on the set-details page by removing the faculty toggle after login. Defaulted unauthenticated sessions to clean Light Mode.

changes.title: Faculty & DptCoor Department Notices Permission Fix
changes.description: Updated Firestore security rules and listener queries for cr_notices to decouple department notices from semester and section for faculty/DptCoor accounts, resolving 'Missing or insufficient permissions' errors.

changes.title: User Management Faculty Role Buttons & DptCoor Filter Matching
changes.description: Hidden 'Make CR' button for Faculty accounts (leaving only 'Make DptCoor' visible) and included DptCoor and DptHead users in the 'Faculty' filter category.

changes.title: Mobile Pending Tasks Compact Filter & Desktop Login 100vh Hero
changes.description: Replaced sprawling task filter pills on mobile with a compact dropdown selector ('Filters: ' prefix and 'Set Filter' placeholder) while keeping 'Clear' accessible. Expanded desktop login card into a 100vh hero section without top padding gaps and added an animated scroll-down indicator to FAQ & Support.

changes.title: Dashboard: Event Raiders Dark Mode Contrast & Task Action Button Row Layout
changes.description: Enhanced Event Raiders contrast in Dark Mode (body.gray-mode) with high-visibility category, deadline, fee, and venue badges matching the blue theme. Placed 'Reset Tasks' button on the same row as 'Add Tasks' and 'View Old' on desktop, and added responsive compact labels ('Reset', 'Add', 'Old') on mobile screens.

changes.title: Dark Mode: Accent Palette Shifted to Blue (#3b82f6)
changes.description: Replaced former red accent (#ff6360) with vibrant blue palette (primary: #3b82f6, secondary/hover: #2563eb, light: #60a5fa) for Dark Mode (body.gray-mode) across css/colors.css, css/classroom.css, css/changelog.css, css/calendar.css, and css/note.css.

changes.title: Profile Settings: Theme Renaming & Reordering (Dark Mode & High Contrast)
changes.description: Updated theme options in Profile Settings (#profile-theme, js/features/profile.js): renamed 'Gray Mode' to 'Dark Mode' (charcoal/gray base) and 'Dark Mode' to 'High Contrast' (pure black/neon green base). Reordered vertical option arrangement to place 'High Contrast' as the final option (System Default -> Light Mode -> Dark Mode -> High Contrast).

changes.title: User Management: Removed 'Remove Details' Action from Edit User Modal
changes.description: Removed the 'Remove Details' button from the footer of the Edit User Profile modal (#edit-user-modal) in User Management, keeping profile editing focused on detail changes. The 'Remove Details' purge action remains accessible via the main User Management account cards and list.

changes.title: Architecture: Categorical Folder Organization for JavaScript Codebase
changes.description: Organized all 37 root JavaScript files into five modular categorical subdirectories: js/core/ (foundational application infrastructure, routing, auth, db, UI, utils), js/features/ (feature modules including classroom, notes, notice, approvals, timeline, and calendar), js/pwa/ (PWA lifecycle, cache management, offline mode, install prompts), js/notifications/ (notification dispatching, content formatting, types), and js/admin/ (activity logging, migration scripts, admin APIs). Updated index.html, sw.js (CACHE_VERSION bumped to v2.53.0), and inject-env.js.

changes.title: Classroom: Decouple Task Completion Checking from Sync to Refresh Button
changes.description: Decoupled task completion auto-checking from the Classroom 'Sync' button to the 'Refresh' button. The 'Sync' button (Classroom.syncAssignmentsToTasks) now strictly focuses on importing and updating coursework into the task database without mutating completion statuses. Automatic checking off of turned-in/graded assignments (and unchecking of unsubmitted assignments) in Pending Tasks is now executed exclusively when clicking the Classroom 'Refresh' button (Classroom.refreshData).

changes.title: User Management 'Remove Details' Action, Firestore Permission Fix & Fallback
changes.description: Renamed 'Delete' button in User Management and Edit User modal to 'Remove Details' for clearer context. Updated firestore.rules to allow admin deletion on user documents and completedTasks subcollections. Enhanced DB.deleteUser with non-fatal completedTasks subcollection cleanup and an automatic fallback that strips all profile details and marks isDeleted: true in the event deployed remote security rules restrict direct deletion. Updated DB.getUserProfile and DB.getAllUsers to filter out and treat stripped records as uninitialized accounts.

changes.title: Classroom: Strict Task ID & Course Matching in Completion Sync
changes.description: Eliminated cross-course false positive task completions during Classroom sync by enforcing strict classroomWorkId equality and requiring both title and courseName matching when resolving synced tasks. In mergeAndSkipUnchanged, merged fresh submission state attributes into cached assignment entries to prevent stale unsubmitted assignments from being retained.

changes.title: Classroom Sync Summary Modal: Border Padding Removal
changes.description: Removed extra desktop outer border padding from the Classroom Sync Summary modal (#classroom-sync-modal .modal-content, .classroom-sync-modal-content) by adding explicit exclusions to .modal-content padding rules in css/responsive.css and setting padding: 0 !important.

changes.title: User Management: Direct Firestore User Deletion & Firebase Auth Cleanup Guidance Modal
changes.description: Resolved orphan Firestore user records by replacing client-side Cloud Function calls with direct Firestore deletion (DB.deleteUser) across users and completedTasks collections. Added a post-deletion guidance modal (#user-delete-auth-modal) explaining that while Firestore records are deleted, the user must also be removed from the Firebase Authentication console for complete removal (otherwise re-login triggers the Set Details onboarding). Features automatic UID copying to clipboard with toast notification, a one-click button redirecting to the project's Firebase Authentication console, and an additional Delete button in the Edit User modal footer.

changes.title: Task Card: Task ID Copy Button Left-Aligned After 'Added by'
changes.description: Adjusted the layout of .task-meta-footer in css/components.css and js/ui.js to align the Task ID copy button (.copy-task-id-btn) flush to the left, sitting immediately adjacent to the 'Added by' attribution text rather than pushed to the far right or forced onto a separate row.

changes.title: Dashboard Task Copy Toasts: Bottom-Right Corner Placement
changes.description: Updated copySingleTask and copyTaskId in js/app.js so that 'Task contents copied to clipboard', 'Task ID copied to clipboard', and their error counterparts all surface at the bottom-right corner (#toast-container-bottom-right), consistent with the UID copy toast behaviour in User Management.

changes.title: Classroom: Task Completion Auto-Sync Restricted to Explicit Sync Button Only
changes.description: Fixed a regression where both the Refresh button and initial Classroom load were auto-checking Pending Tasks as completed, regardless of actual submission status. Removed calls to syncTurnedInAssignmentsToUserCompletions() from fetchAssignmentsData() and the expired-session cache path (showCachedDataWithBanner). Task completion state is now exclusively updated when the user explicitly clicks the Sync button (syncAssignmentsToTasks), which is the only authoritative action for writing to the task database. Refresh is now strictly read-only with respect to completion state.

changes.title: Bottom-Right Corner Placement for User Management UID Copy Toast
changes.description: Updated UI.showToast in js/ui.js and copyUserUid in js/app.js so that the 'Copied UID: <uid>' popup notification surfaces at the bottom-right corner (#toast-container-bottom-right) instead of the top-right, with smooth bottom-entrance animations and responsive mobile edge boundaries.

changes.title: Profile & Registration: Lockdown Manual Selection of Alumni / Special Semester
changes.description: Restricted the Semester dropdown in Profile Settings (js/profile.js) and Set Details (js/app.js) so users cannot see or select 'alumni / special'. Alumni / special semester status can now only be assigned through automated promotion logic or explicitly by an Administrator in the User Management view. Preserved display of 'alumni / special' in disabled/readonly state only for accounts already carrying the status.

changes.title: Profile View: Dynamic Faculty ID Label for Faculty Accounts
changes.description: Updated the profile header in Profile Settings (#profile-settings-view) so that the user ID paragraph (#profile-student-id) dynamically renders as 'Faculty ID: <ID or Initial>' when logged in as a faculty member (Faculty, DptCoor, or DptHead) or when an Admin is previewing as faculty, and 'Student ID: <ID>' for students and standard accounts.

changes.title: Classroom Sync: Strict Turned-In Constraint for Task Completion
changes.description: Fixed an issue where syncing Classroom assignments caused corresponding tasks in Pending Tasks to be marked as checked off/completed even when the student had not submitted and turned in the assignment. Updated isSubmittedOrReturned() and fetchAssignmentsData() in js/classroom.js to strictly verify that the assignment is actually turned in (TURNED_IN or RETURNED with verified submissionHistory) rather than treating teacher-returned or graded unsubmitted work as completed. Enhanced syncAssignmentsToTasks() and syncTurnedInAssignmentsToUserCompletions() so only actually submitted assignments are checked off, while unsubmitted, missing, or reclaimed/unsubmitted assignments remain unchecked, automatically unchecking any erroneously completed tasks.

changes.title: Pending Tasks UI Refinements: Border Removal, Compact Padding, Inline Desktop Meta & Single Task Copy
changes.description: Refined the Pending Tasks card appearance by removing left accent borders from .task-card and .task-description-wrapper, and reducing card padding to 10px 14px for a sleeker dashboard layout. Replaced visible Task ID strings with a dedicated copy button (.copy-task-id-btn), aligned beside 'Added by' in a unified single row on desktop viewports (min-width: 769px). Added a top-right single task copy button (.task-card-copy-btn) that exports complete single task information matching the format of full Pending Tasks exports with clipboard feedback.

changes.title: Filter Users Modal: Faculty Read-Only Constraints for Semester & Section
changes.description: Enforced read-only constraints on Semester and Section selectors (#filter-semester, #filter-section) inside the User Management Filter Users modal (#filter-popup) when faculty roles ('Faculty' or 'DptCoor') are selected. Added transparent overlay interceptors that show a brief floating popup notice and toast message informing the user that semester and sections are not defined for faculties. Automatically bypasses semester and section filtering when faculty roles are active.

changes.title: Remove Make/Remove Faculty Button in User Management
changes.description: Removed the obsolete Make Faculty and Remove Faculty action button (.toggle-faculty-btn) from the User Management view in js/app.js. Since faculty members self-register directly through the dedicated Faculty registration flow and are verified via Account Approvals, student-to-faculty conversion buttons are redundant. Preserved the Make/Remove DptCoor promotion button for verified faculty accounts.

changes.title: Account Approvals Desktop Modal Border Padding Removal & Mobile Badge Top-Left Positioning
changes.description: Removed outer border padding in the Account Approvals modal (#approval-modal, .approval-modal-content) on desktop screens, ensuring header and list content sit seamlessly flush with modal boundaries. Repositioned the mobile bookmark toggle count indicator (#approval-badge-count-mobile) to the top-left corner of the button (-5px, -5px) with theme border styling instead of rendering below the button icon.

changes.title: Full Vertical Height & Bottom Border Removal for All Mobile Sidebars
changes.description: Standardized all mobile flyout sidebars (Events, Notices, and Account Approvals) to match the Google Classroom sidebar layout. Replaced 100vh with 100% / 100dvh pinned to top: 0 and bottom: 0, removed downward box-shadows and bottom borders, eliminating bottom gaps and border lines on mobile displays and during zoom scaling.

changes.title: Desktop Bottom-Right PWA Install Prompt with Post-Login Deferral & 5-Second Auto-Dismiss
changes.description: Positioned the 'Install b1t-Sched' web app installation popup (.install-prompt) at the bottom-right corner on desktop screens (bottom: 24px, right: 24px) with smooth slideInRight entrance animation, while retaining centered bottom placement on mobile displays. Deferred the installation prompt so it only displays after leaving the login view, and implemented a 5-second auto-dismiss countdown on inactive prompts with hover and touch pause-and-resume support.

changes.title: Login Screen Overhaul: Student/Faculty Toggle, High-Contrast Password Eye, oU1TS Telegram & FAQ Section
changes.description: Revamped the login and registration experience across #login-view, #signup-view, and #set-details-view. Added an interactive segmented Student / Faculty role toggle (.auth-role-toggle) supporting dual authentication logic: students can log in with their 10–16 digit numeric ID or email, while faculty members can log in using their official Name Initial (e.g. ABC) or email. Integrated a custom high-contrast password visibility eye toggle (.password-toggle-btn) with tailored contrast for Light, Dark, and Gray themes while suppressing native Edge/IE duplicates. Added a dedicated footer section to the login view featuring the official oU1TS Telegram community contact card (t.me/oUITS_res) and an expandable FAQ accordion.

changes.title: Firebase User UID Copy Button in User Management
changes.description: Added a dedicated copy button (.copy-user-uid-btn) displaying beside user emails across all user cards in the User Management view (#user-management-view) and Edit User modal (#edit-user-modal). Clicking the button copies the user's Firebase Auth UID to the clipboard with animated checkmark feedback and toast notification, making it fast and effortless for Admins to search and locate specific accounts directly in the Firebase Console. Also extended user search filtering to support direct matching against Firebase UIDs.

changes.title: Decouple Database Task Sync from Classroom Refresh
changes.description: Streamlined Classroom.refreshData() in js/classroom.js to strictly fetch fresh coursework and announcements from Google Classroom, update local caches/UI, and show Classroom changes. Decoupled and eliminated redundant Firestore database task writes from the Refresh action, preserving the Admin/CR Sync button (syncAssignmentsToTasks) as the single authoritative mechanism for pushing assignments into shared schedule tasks.

changes.title: Classroom Sync Briefing Modal with GitHub-Style Version Control Diff View
changes.description: Replaced plain JavaScript alert popups during Google Classroom sync and refresh with an interactive briefing modal (#classroom-sync-modal). Displays exactly which assignments and instruction captions were added or updated, direct post links (View in Classroom), and manual dropdown toggles (View Changes) rendering GitHub-style commit diff views with line-by-line additions (+), deletions (-), file attachment changes, and deadline modifications.

changes.title: Firebase Task ID Display on Expanded Pending Task Cards
changes.description: Integrated Firestore task ID metadata into the Pending Tasks cards (.task-id-info), displayed automatically alongside creator details when the 'Show more' description toggle is expanded. Features quick-select monospace formatting.

changes.title: Old Tasks Direct Editing & Automatic Reappearance in Pending Tasks
changes.description: Enabled role-based editing directly within the Old Tasks modal (.old-task-edit-btn) for Admins and task creators (Students, CRs, and Faculty). Updating an old task deadline to a future date or removing the deadline immediately transfers the task back into Pending Tasks and refreshes all views in real time.

changes.title: Faculty Self-Registration, Unapproved State & Account Approvals Modal/Sidebar
changes.description: Added a 'Faculty Account' registration toggle in initial setup (set-details-view) allowing faculty members to register with their initials without semester/section constraints. Introduced unapproved faculty state with (unapproved) badge tag in Profile Settings until verified. Implemented an Account Approvals system featuring a desktop shield button (above Notes) and an elevated mobile bookmark toggle/sidebar (bottom: 355px) with full Light, Dark, and Gray theme styling and proper non-blocking overlay state management.

changes.title: User Role Display, DptCoor Role, Faculty Department Notices, Role FAQs & Admin Role Preview Mode
changes.description: Introduced the new DptCoor role (Department Coordinator) for faculty leadership with exclusive authority to post Department Notices, custom teal badge styling, and direct Make/Remove DptCoor management controls in User Management. For Faculty and DptCoor users, updated Notice modals to display 'Department Notices' in place of 'CR Notices' with department-wide scope, hidden semester/section profile selectors, added 'Course / Designation' task labeling with 'Task for a Faculty / Course' placeholder, and added a 'Meetings' task type. Enhanced the home page FAQ with complete role context documentation. Profile Settings now includes role badge displays and an interactive 2-row 'Preview as' dropdown for Admins with a floating eye-icon banner that auto-minimizes every 3 seconds.

changes.title: Google Classroom Announcement & Assignment Creation Option for Faculty & CR Roles
changes.description: Added a dedicated floating action button (.classroom-create-fab) positioned at the bottom-right corner of the Classroom mobile sidebar and desktop modal for Faculty and CR users. Triggers a template modal with a 3-second redirect countdown to Google Classroom with immediate action options.

changes.title: Calendar View Task Description Clickable Links & Dropdown Toggle
changes.description: Enabled rich markdown formatting and clickable hyperlink rendering (Utils.escapeAndLinkify) for task descriptions and details in the Calendar Task Details modal, accompanied by a collapsible dropdown button ('Show more' / 'Show less') with multi-line clamping and full theme support.

changes.title: LocalSend Web Direct Sharing Integration
changes.description: Added a direct link to LocalSend Web (https://web.localsend.org/) within the personal Note Taking modal footer upload instructions for local network peer-to-peer file sharing between devices.

changes.title: Google Classroom Window Border Padding Removal
changes.description: Eliminated unwanted outer modal padding on smaller desktop and height-constrained screens (769px–1366px), allowing the Google Classroom window to render flush against screen bounds without nested spacing.

changes.title: Classroom To-Do Upcoming Deadlines Priority & Past Deadline Banners
changes.description: Restructured the To-Do assignments view to prioritize tasks with active upcoming deadlines at the top in chronological order (earliest deadline first), followed by assigned tasks with no due date, and introduced a compact 'Past deadline' divider banner with task count for overdue assignments.

changes.title: Completed Tasks Sub-Grouping & Deadline Classification
changes.description: Enhanced the Completed assignments section to vertically organize tasks based on remaining deadline status (early/on-time submissions first, followed by a 'Past deadline' sub-banner and late-submitted tasks), with full theme support across Default, Dark, and Gray modes.

changes.title: UITS Event Raiders Live RSS & JSON Feed Syndication
changes.description: Syndicated active competitions, hackathons, olympiads, and symposiums live from ou1ts/events (https://ou1ts.github.io/events/raids.json) with RSS 2.0 XML fallback, 30-minute caching, and deep-links to event entries.

changes.title: Desktop Sticky Sidebar Dedicated Events Layout
changes.description: Organized the desktop sidebar with generous vertical separation between upcoming academic events and syndicated Event Raiders, ensuring both have dedicated full-width vertical space without horizontal scroll or cramped cards.

changes.title: Mobile Events Sidebar Arrowhead View Switcher
changes.description: Integrated a vertically centered solid maroon right-arrowhead toggle button (#events-view-switch-btn) on the left border of the mobile events sidebar that switches views between b1t-Sched internal events and UITS Event Raiders.

changes.title: Mobile Events Sidebar View State Persistence
changes.description: Saved active mobile events sidebar view ('internal' vs 'raiders') to localStorage ('b1t_events_sidebar_view') so user view preference is remembered and automatically restored across app sessions.

changes.title: Two-Segment Event Card Grid Layout
changes.description: Structured event cards into two segments where the header sits beside the date badge and all descriptions, badges, and action buttons span the full width directly below the date badge, eliminating wasted space.

changes.title: Compact Mobile Events Sidebar Header
changes.description: Reduced top and bottom padding on the mobile events drawer header to allocate more vertical screen real estate for event listings.

changes.title: Offline Banner Dedicated Layout Space & Dynamic Height Offset
changes.description: Re-engineered the offline banner with dynamic height measurement (ResizeObserver) and CSS variable (--offline-banner-height) to provide dedicated space and push the navbar, main content, mobile drawer sidebars (Events, Notices, Classroom) & backdrops, and login screen down cleanly without overlaying or obscuring top website elements.

changes.title: Google Classroom Real-Time Assignment Status Badges
changes.description: Integrated real-time submission tracking (studentSubmissions API) to display bottom-right status indicators on all To-Do assignments for Missing (Red), Assigned (Blue), Turned in (Green), and Returned/Graded (Purple) across light, dark, and gray themes.

changes.title: To-Do Two-Group Vertical Task Arrangement
changes.description: Separated active/pending assignments from completed ones so that pending assignments stay clearly in view at the top, while turned-in assignments are neatly grouped below, each sorted in ascending order of due dates.

changes.title: Automatic Pending Tasks Completion Synchronization
changes.description: Whenever you sign into Google Classroom or open the Classroom window, turned-in or graded assignments automatically check the corresponding tasks in your personal Pending Tasks list in Firestore.

changes.title: Two-Way Task Sync with In-Place Updates
changes.description: Clicking the Sync button in Classroom To-Do now adds new assignments and automatically updates existing tasks if a teacher modifies deadlines, titles, or descriptions in Google Classroom.

changes.title: Classroom Desktop Minimum Width & Overflow Protection
changes.description: Enforced an 800px minimum width on the desktop Classroom modal with horizontal scroll support, preventing coursework cards and headers from being squeezed on compact and 1366x768 laptop displays.

changes.title: Changelog Modal Theme Colors & Vivid Badges
changes.description: Enhanced font brightness and contrast in dark and gray modes for changelog descriptions, dates, and subtitle texts. Added bright, high-contrast category badges for New Feature, Fix & Enhancement, Security, and Major updates.

changes.title: Calendar Desktop Minimum Width & Cell Sizing
changes.description: Enforced an 820px minimum width on the desktop calendar modal content and 780px on the calendar grid with horizontal overflow support, preventing task items and course names from being squeezed on compact displays.

changes.title: Protruding Floating Close Button & Unclipped Corner
changes.description: Redesigned the calendar modal close button to float over the top-right corner with 360-degree rotation and scale micro-interactions. Eliminated container corner clipping by enforcing visible overflow and elevated z-index.

changes.title: Theme-Adaptive Month & Year Dropdown Chevrons
changes.description: Replaced harsh red dropdown arrows with sleek, modern stroke chevrons tuned to match active Light, Dark (lime green), and Gray (lavender/silver) themes.

changes.title: Hidden Scrollbars Across Calendar Window
changes.description: Applied cross-browser scrollbar hiding across the calendar grid, weekly views, mobile date lists, and task detail modals while retaining full smooth scrolling via touch, mouse wheel, and trackpad.

changes.title: Version Update & What's New Modal
changes.description: Interactive changelog modal that automatically notifies users whenever a new service worker version is deployed, loading update history directly from changes.json with direct links to full documentation.

changes.title: Persistent Task Type Filters & Re-clickable Controls
changes.description: Task list filters (Assignment, Homework, Exam, Project, Presentation, Other) remain strictly active when checking/unchecking tasks or deleting entries. Filter buttons are re-clickable to instantly refresh the filtered view.

changes.title: Dynamic Department & Metadata Options Architecture
changes.description: Resolved issue where new departments added in Firestore did not reflect on the frontend. Added server-priority fetching, multi-structure document support, dynamic event department selectors, and dropdown state preservation.

changes.title: Smaller Desktop Display Responsiveness (1366x768px)
changes.description: Added optimized typography, spacing, card dimensions, and UI scaling specifically tuned for compact desktop displays and standard 1366x768 laptop screens.

changes.title: Dedicated Semester Notice Dismissal Flag
changes.description: Semester auto-promotion notice dismissal is now persisted to the user profile in Firestore database (semesterNoticeDismissedCycle), keeping the banner dismissed across multiple logins until the next promotion cycle.

changes.title: Google Classroom Materials Tab
changes.description: Added Materials view toggle alongside To-Do and Notices to view all posted course materials across active courses, powered by Google Classroom courseWorkMaterials API.

changes.title: Client JSON Template Caching & Incremental Sync
changes.description: Structured JSON template caching for offline access across token expirations, with fingerprinting to skip unchanged items during background sync.

changes.title: Hover Expand Dropdown & Attachment Pills
changes.description: Interactive hover expand button on Classroom list items rendering Google Drive files, YouTube videos, and forms as clickable pills.

changes.title: Quick Links Dropdown & Calendar View Prominence
changes.description: Replaced resource links grid with a compact Quick Links dropdown header button and elevated Calendar View button prominence on desktop.

changes.title: Font Awesome v5/v6/v7 Cross-Version Support
changes.description: Upgraded Font Awesome to v6.7.2 with full cross-version syntax support across all themes.

changes.title: DOM Layout Card Breakdown & Expand Button Alignment
changes.description: Prevented nested links in announcement bodies from splitting card layouts and pinned expand chevrons to top-right.

changes.title: Google Classroom Session Persistence
changes.description: Preserves connected status across 1-hour access token expirations with silent token renewal and cached fallback.

changes.title: Unified Classroom Header Sign Out Button
changes.description: Single pill-styled Sign Out button added to top window title headers, removing duplicate buttons.

changes.title: Semester Auto-Promotion Cycle Tracking
changes.description: Banner dismissal tracked per semester cycle in July and January.

changes.title: Environment Variable Migration
changes.description: Migrated standard Firebase API keys inside firebase-config.js to environment variables with strict HTTP referrers restriction.

changes.title: Enhanced Markdown & Code Blocks
changes.description: Global support for fenced code blocks, preformatted tags, and safe HTML entities across tasks, events, notices, and notes.

changes.title: Note PDF Export Dark Mode Contrast
changes.description: Forced white background and black text repainting during PDF generation to ensure perfect readability in dark themes.

changes.title: Classroom Drop-in Refresh
changes.description: Manual refresh button to clear cached items and fetch fresh assignments and announcements on demand.

changes.title: PWA Offline View Loading & Deferred Login
changes.description: Deferred Google Classroom silent auth to prevent login flash on startup. Improved offline banner mobile layout.

changes.title: Task Card Layout & Title Overlap Fix
changes.description: Optimized description width below checkboxes and fixed title wrap for long task headings.

changes.title: Note PDF Export & Client-Side ZIP Compression
changes.description: Integrated html2pdf.js for note exports and JSZip for automatic client-side compression of unsupported file types.

changes.title: Urgent Deadline Visibility & Preloader Synchronization
changes.description: High-contrast urgent deadline text in dark mode and synchronized dashboard revealing after full data load.

changes.title: Gray Mode Monochromatic Theme
changes.description: Sleek low-strain monochromatic theme set as system dark mode default across Classroom, Timeline, and Dashboards.

changes.title: Overdue Task Highlights
changes.description: Redesigned overdue task cards for all dark themes to guarantee clarity without harsh contrast.

changes.title: Classroom Sync to Tasks
changes.description: One-click synchronization of active Google Classroom assignments into b1t-Sched tasks for Admins and CRs with duplicate prevention.

changes.title: Student Search & Semester Auto-Promotion
changes.description: Real-time user search bar in User Management and automatic semester advancement in July and January with cooldown protection.

changes.title: Mobile Monthly Calendar View
changes.description: Compact date grid with week numbers, dot indicators, and tappable date task panels.

changes.title: Activity Timeline Heatmap & Live User Counter
changes.description: Interactive productivity heatmap, weekly bar charts, and live active user count.

changes.title: Progressive Web App (PWA) & Calendar View
changes.description: Full offline support, Service Worker caching, install prompt management, and desktop monthly calendar view.

changes.title: Complete Redesign as SPA with Firebase
changes.description: Rebuilt from ground up as a Single Page Application with Firebase Authentication, Firestore database, and role-based access control.
